description: Turn the Build Your Own X tutorial directory into a structured, source-grounded plan for learning systems by implementing them from scratch.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Build Your Own X Guide to pick or work through a build-from-scratch software project. Prefer tutorials from https://github.com/codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x, match scope to my skills and time, explain the concepts, define testable milestones, and distinguish source-backed facts from assumptions.
interface.longDescription: A project-based learning guide grounded in the codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x tutorial catalog. Helps choose an appropriate build-from-scratch project, break it into milestones, explain the underlying concepts, design tests, and review progress without claiming to execute code or inspect unavailable repositories.

name: build-your-own-x-guide
